name: SIA 497 起落架问题 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 497, you are parking at gate 215, you have got information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 497，停在 215 号登机口，已收到 P 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 497, gate 215, information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 497，215 号登机口，收到 P 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, cleared to SIA via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700m. departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA。LKO-01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 10700m。离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706。
cards.referenceText: cleared to SIA via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 1700 meters. departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA。LKO-01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 1700 米。离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: tell ATC 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉 ATC，由于重量大，10700 米不可接受，请求 9500 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 497, 1700 is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 497，由于重量大，1700 不可接受，请求 9500 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
B: You are on the taxiway A with engine running, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 A 滑行道上，发动机运转，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 497, taxiway A, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 497，A 滑行道，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via Z4 and A, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，在 E7 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R via Z four and A, hold short of E seven, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，在 E7 前等待，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: Contact Wuhan Tower and request intersection departure E5 Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 联系武汉塔台，请求从 E5 交叉口使用 Runway 36R 起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 497, request intersection departure E five Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 497，请求从 E5 交叉口使用 Runway 36R 起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, Negative due sequencing, continue to holding point Runway 36R, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，不行，因排序需要，继续前往 Runway 36R 等待点，在 E7 前等待。
cards.referenceText: roger, continue to holding point Runway 36R, hold short of E seven, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续前往 Runway 36R 等待点，在 E7 前等待，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, surface wind 350, five knots.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，许可从 Runway 36R 起飞，地面风 350，5 节。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne, passing 600m, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，正通过 600m，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 497, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 497，已离地，正通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，武汉离场，雷达识别，左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: Your landing gear can't be extended normally, report this situation to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架不能正常放下，向 ATC 报告这个情况。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA 497, our landing gear can't be extended normally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA 497，我们的起落架不能正常放下。

cards.audioText: Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain 600 meters on runway heading, to complete the abnormal procedures.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉 ATC，你想终止进近，在跑道航向上保持 600 米，以完成非正常程序。
cards.referenceText: request terminate the approach, maintain 600 meters on runway heading, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求终止进近，在跑道航向上保持 600 米，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: Your landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA 497, our landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA 497，我们的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。

cards.audioText: roger, SIA 497, the tug will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，SIA 497，牵引车将在落地时就位。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, you are No. 1 to land, cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，你是第一架落地航空器，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, report established, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，建立后报告，SIA 497。
